verdict.rationale: MoonPay's Web SDK documents a delete-payment-method call for when a customer asks to forget a card, which is a first-party deletion control but covers only stored cards. The reset-connection method only clears the browser session on sign-out, so it is an adjacent control rather than data deletion. missing for 10: configurable data-retention policies, deletion of customer account/KYC data, data export or erasure API, documented retention periods, independent corroboration.
